   Problem: The run list disables Select unless the browser already has a plaintext token for that run in localStorage. Because /api/runs returns persisted runs without tokens and tokens are stored hashed in the DB, an operator opening the dashboard after a process restart in a fresh browser/session, or trying to select a run created by another client, can list the run but cannot select it; using the operator token on existing data tabs leaves request.state.run_id empty and falls back to global JSON instead of scoping to the selected run. This violates AC5's requirement that after restart the dashboard list all runs and selecting a run scopes existing data tabs to that run.
   Required fix: Add an operator-mediated selection path for persisted runs, such as an operator-only endpoint that mints a fresh per-run token for an existing run_id or a server-side operator selection mode that validates the run_id without allowing run tokens to choose arbitrary runs. Update the sessions UI to use that path instead of disabling rows without cached localStorage tokens, and add a regression test with no smith_run_tokens localStorage proving selecting run A scopes /api/findings, /api/session, /api/coverage, and related tabs to run A rather than global data or run B.
